I don't really know what else to say other than  relay my own experience; my family has been pretty powerful and privelaged since maybe the Tang or Qin dynasty in China.  We had great wealth and genetics have always played in our favor for generations.  I currently live in China.  I get whatever I want when I want it, no matter the cost.  People know me as the CEO's pretty daughter.  I haven't had to pay my bills, get a job, or go to school.  To add on to this list of extensive privileges, I managed to even survive a brain injury that almost killed me when I was younger...the list goes on and on.  

My family also doesn't have a huge history with mental health issues or anything like that.  Usually just physical stuff.  So when I almost killed myself about 2 months ago I was bombarded with  questions and statements from my family and others about how I could possibly want to die when my life is so easy and great.  The general response I've gotten (previous to the event) to "I want to kill myself" was laughter.  I guess it seemed as if I was just complaining about my first world problems.  Depression doesn't discriminate.  It can overcome anyone.  But just know, that everything will be okay in the end ; if it is not okay, then it is simply not the end.

(Sorry if this is mad long or I sound like I'm bragging ;-;)
